posts.description: As the World Cup begins, it’s time for my tradition of predicting every match to pick an eventual winner. I have the semi-finals as France vs. Spain and Brazil vs. Portugal, with France beating Portugal in the final ⚽️

posts.title: The Movies I Watched in 2025 🍿
posts.description: I watched 82 movies in 2025 (excluding rewatches), down from 119 in 2024. I’m setting myself a goal of getting that back over 100 for 2026. Here are my highlights (and the lowlight): Favorite movie: Nine Days Favorite movie released in 2025: Sinners Least favorite movie: Fifty Shades of Grey The full list: Wicked Little Letters 3 out of 5 stars Spice World 3 out of 5 stars Cunk on Life 4 out of 5

My home screen has changed a lot since I last posted it. I’m now back to using stock icons in their large size with automatic dark mode—although I wish Apple would allow for a 7th row above the dock. I use Ivory for both Mastodon and Bluesky—the only social media sites I remain active on. And I’ve switched to Apple Podcasts from Pocket Casts as I move away from Automattic’s products.
